description: The CT Cranium DICOM scan is already loaded in InVesalius 3. A neuroimaging researcher needs the raw volumetric bone segmentation for analysis. Create a bone segmentation mask using the standard 'Bone' threshold preset (226 to 3071 HU). Then, export this mask as a compressed NIfTI file to '/home/ga/Documents/bone_mask.nii.gz'. Note: You must export the mask volume itself (often found under 'Import/Export' or by right-clicking the mask), not a 3D surface mesh.
